tasks.title: G1 — Named-tunnel + custom-domain runbook
tasks.detail: Test `cloudflared tunnel run --token` with a Zero Trust named tunnel, document DNS/CNAME setup, and make a malformed token fail loudly. Add a unit test for the composed command line. Owner files: roblox-bridge/tunnel_manager.py, docs/OPS.md.

tasks.title: G2 — Tunnel latency budget (p50/p95)
tasks.detail: Measure /mcp + /api/jobs overhead through the quick tunnel vs localhost for ping_studio, get_studio_state and script_read (20 calls each). Add the table to docs/OPS.md using metrics --prometheus.
tasks.result: script landed in 5.1.0 (jobs/measure_tunnel_latency.py); numbers pending an operator run

tasks.title: G3 — Ops tab responsive + SSE reconnect
tasks.detail: Make the Ops tab work at 390x844: stack cards, add a 'copy MCP config with tunnel URL' button, and reconnect the EventSource with backoff. Touch only the dashboard JS/HTML inside roblox-bridge/server.py.
tasks.result: landed in 5.1.0: responsive Ops tab, reconnecting EventSource, copy MCP config

tasks.title: G4 — Multi-agent MCP prompt recipes
tasks.detail: Add prompts multi_agent_handoff, bus_standup and task_triage that teach agents to use the bus, rendering live bus state. Edit only PROMPTS and get_mcp_prompt in mcp_core.py.
tasks.result: landed in 5.1.0: 7 MCP prompts with live bus state and offline fallback

tasks.title: G5 — Stale-agent sweeper
tasks.detail: Release tasks held by agents offline > 15 min, broadcast an alert, and increment bridge_agents_reaped_total. Unit-test with fake clocks; keep handle() action names stable.
tasks.result: landed in 5.1.0: sweep_stale + stats counters + broadcast alert

tasks.title: G6 — Handoff brief `since` + summaryOnly
tasks.detail: Let action='export' accept since (cursor) and summaryOnly so the brief contains only recent activity. Keep existing export tests green and add coverage.

tasks.title: G7 — Live Studio acceptance run
tasks.detail: With Studio open: setup.py --tunnel, start tunnel from the Ops tab, verify state=online and health.ok=true, call bridge_ops status from an MCP client, confirm self_test studioSmoke=pass. Paste JSON into docs/OPS.md 'Live acceptance'.

tasks.title: G8 — Kill-switch drill
tasks.detail: Stop Studio mid-job. Confirm bridge_jobs_reaped_total increments, the job returns to queued and completes when Studio reconnects. Record the event feed excerpt.

messages.subject: v5 ops platform is live on this branch
messages.body: Tunnel supervisor, scoped tokens, agent bus, metrics/audit and the Ops tab are in. Agent bus actions are stable: register/heartbeat/post/inbox/tasks/task_claim/task_complete/export. Please claim tasks G1..G8 before editing so we do not collide.
